_help: Projects shown on the Home page (featured: true, up to 6 look best) and the Projects page (all with published: true). HOW TO ADD A PROJECT: 1) Upload a photo to /img/projects/ (landscape, about 1200px wide, JPG or WebP). 2) Copy the TEMPLATE block at the bottom, paste it above it, fill in the details and set published to true. 3) Keep a comma between blocks. client, location and year are optional - leave them as empty quotes if you don't want them shown.
